title: ELF file errors on new PKGBUILD for littlefedi
body: Hi, I'm having a go at writing my first PKGBUILD for littlefedi and am using the following to guide my learning... [ul] [li] Arch Wiki : Creating Packages [/li] [li] Arch Wiki : PKGBUILD [/li] [/ul] I've come up with the following, the .service files that come with the package point to /usr/local/bin so I tweak these to point to /usr/bin # Maintainer: slackline <slackline at mymail dot com> pkgname=littlefedi pkgrel=1 pkgdesc="A small ActivityPub server written in Go with SQLite, local media storage and a web interface that works without JavaScript." url="https://littlefedi.org/" license=('MIT') makedepends=('go') install= changelog= source=("${url}/downloads/${pkgname}-${pkgver}-source.tar.gz") noextract=() sha256sums=('55a8e305893dc7f72f2062406a941b9efb397c6548d909213a621fabb9d17f44') validpgpkeys=() build() { cd "${pkgname}-${pkgver}" make build-blog } prepare() { cd "${srcdir}/${pkgname}-${pkgver}/packaging/linux" # .service files look for binaries in /usr/local/bin/ switch to /usr/bin/ sed -i "s/local\///" *.service # Switch user to root in service file (unclear how to create user/groups post_install() doesn't appear to run) sed -i "s/=littlefedi/=root/" littlefedi.service } package() { install -Dm 755 "${pkgname}-${pkgver}/littlefedi-blog" "${pkgdir}/usr/bin/littlefedi" install -Dm 644 "${pkgname}-${pkgver}/config/littlefedi.toml.example" "${pkgdir}/etc/littlefedi/littlefedi.toml.example" install -Dm 644 "${pkgname}-${pkgver}/config/config.go" "${pkgdir}/etc/littlefedi/config.go" install -Dm 644 "${pkgname}-${pkgver}/config/littlemesh-directory.toml.example" "${pkgdir}/etc/littlefedi/littlemesh-directory.toml.example" install -Dm 644 "${pkgname}-${pkgver}/packaging/linux/littlefedi.service" "${pkgdir}/usr/lib/systemd/system/littlefedi.service" install -Dm 644 "${pkgname}-${pkgver}/packaging/linux/littlefedi-directory.service" "${pkgdir}/usr/lib/systemd/system/littlefedi-directory.service" install -Dm 644 "${pkgname}-${pkgver}/packaging/linux/littlefedi-lighthouse.service" "${pkgdir}/usr/lib/systemd/system/littlefedi-lighthouse.service" touch "${pkgdir}/etc/littlefedi/littlefedi.env" install -Dm 644 "${pkgname}-${pkgver}/LICENSE" "${pkgdir}/usr/share/licenses/littlefedi/LICENSE" mkdir -p "${pkgdir}/var/lib/littlefedi" } post_install() { useradd --no-create-home --user-group littlefedi chown -R littleffedi:littlefedi /var/lib/littlefedi echo "" echo "LittleFedi" echo "==========" echo "" echo "To get started with LittleFedi answer the prompts to..." echo "" echo " littlefedi init [--config /etc/littlefedi/littlefedi.toml]" echo "" echo "The resulting configuration file can be edited and you should" echo "consult the '/etc/littlefedi/littlefedi.toml.example for more" echo "options." echo "" echo "See also the official documentation for mor information : " echo "" echo "https://littlefedi.org/docs.html" } Running makepkg completes but with a warning... ❱ makepkg -f ==> Making package: littlefedi 26.10.13-1 (Sun 25 Oct 2026 12:06:12 GMT) ==> Checking runtime dependencies... ==> Checking buildtime dependencies... ==> Retrieving sources... -> Found littlefedi-26.10.13-source.tar.gz ==> Validating source files with sha256sums... littlefedi-26.10.13-source.tar.gz ... Passed ==> Extracting sources... -> Extracting littlefedi-26.10.13-source.tar.gz with bsdtar ==> Starting prepare()... ==> Starting build()... CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags="-s -w -buildid= -X brew.bsd.cafe/littlecomputerpeople/littlef edi/internal/version.Version=26.10.13" -tags " blog" -o littlefedi-blog ./cmd/littlefedi ==> Entering fakeroot environment... ==> Starting package()... ==> Tidying install... -> Removing libtool files... -> Removing static library files... -> Purging unwanted files... -> Stripping unneeded symbols from binaries and libraries... Error while writing index for `/home/neil/aur/littlefedi/pkg/littlefedi/usr/bin/littlefedi': No debugging symbols gdb-add-index: No index was created for ./usr/bin/littlefedi gdb-add-index: [Was there no debuginfo?
